cases.prompt: Explain why the sky is blue.

source_documents.name: sky.txt
source_documents.text: During the day the sky appears blue. Sunlight is made of many colours. Gases in the air deflect short wavelengths more than long ones. Blue is a short-wavelength colour. That scattered blue reaches the eye from every direction. The effect is known as Rayleigh scattering. Near sunset sunlight crosses more air. The same effect explains the changing colours at sunset.
